name: shizumu
description: a private writing app. write to think, pin what matters, trail what continues.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:rust && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:loom: node --test scripts/sync/*.test.mjs scripts/sync/loom-instance/*.test.mjs scripts/desktop/*.test.mjs && cd ../factory && node --test loom/*.test.mjs loom/*/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:vr:docker: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -v vr_node_modules:/app/node_modules -w /app -e VITE_VR=1 $(docker build -q -f Dockerfile.vr .) sh -c 'npm ci && npm run test:vr:all'
scripts.test:vr:docker:update: docker run --rm -v "$PWD":/app -v vr_node_modules:/app/node_modules -w /app -e VITE_VR=1 $(docker build -q -f Dockerfile.vr .) sh -c 'npm ci && npm run test:vr:all -- --update-snapshots'
scripts.test:vr:linux: VITE_VR=1 npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cd e2e && xvfb-run -a npm run vr:capture
scripts.test:vr:linux:update: VITE_VR=1 npm run build && cargo build --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cd e2e && xvfb-run -a npm run vr:update
scripts.test:vr:android: VITE_VR=1 npx tauri android build --apk --debug && cd e2e && VR_APK="$(cd .. && find src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk -name '*debug*.apk' | head -1)" npm run vr:android
scripts.test:vr:android:update: VITE_VR=1 npx tauri android build --apk --debug && cd e2e && VR_APK="$(cd .. && find src-tauri/gen/android/app/build/outputs/apk -name '*debug*.apk' | head -1)" npm run vr:android:update
scripts.test:website: npm --prefix website run build && playwright test --config playwright.website.config.js
